summary: Retested backend APIs, physics harness, real mirror/remote browser flows, and TEST-ONLY worker-fixture pose flow. Core APIs and major UI integrations pass; one frontend startup/load-race issue remains around aborted GLB/texture requests and repeated WebGL readback stalls.

integration_issues.flow: Mirror startup / garment loading (real worker path)
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent request aborts were captured in console logs during mirror runs (e.g., /api/static/shirt.glb and texture blob URLs), followed by GLTFLoader texture load errors in one run.
Repeated browser warning: 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' on mirror page while camera/WebGL active.

action_items: Investigate and harden garment load lifecycle to avoid intermittent /api/static/shirt.glb + blob texture aborts during mirror lifecycle transitions.
Profile and reduce WebGL readback pressure causing repeated 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warnings on mirror.
Optional perf cleanup: reduce per-frame React state churn in Mirror render loop (pose/fps updates) if low-FPS behavior persists on weaker devices.
critical_code_review_comments: Mirror loop updates React state every frame (`setPoseCount`) which can cause avoidable rerenders and UI-thread pressure under camera/WebGL load.
`takeSnapshot` forces an extra render+readback path; combined with current render loop this likely contributes to observed ReadPixels stall warnings.
Worker migration is correctly isolated to CPU worker (`poseWorker`) and compile overlay regression is resolved (no 'Failed to compile' overlay observed).
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md: public demo, no auth credentials required.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple disposable session tokens via POST /api/sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real worker path validated: MediaPipe worker initializes and reaches READY (~5-7s in this environment). Real synthetic webcam did not provide a human body, so POSE often remained 0/33 in non-fixture runs. TEST-ONLY worker fixture injection produced deterministic 33/33, DRAPE LIVE, snapshot modal/download, clear/reapply behavior, and upright straight-pose checks. Mirror<->Remote cloth toggle propagation, fit/view/skeleton updates, garment color selections, session persistence/reload, and responsive no-horizontal-overflow checks passed.
rca of the issue: Repro 1 (intermittent load abort): run mirror startup/navigation automation and inspect console logs; saw /api/static/shirt.glb and blob texture aborts followed by GLTFLoader texture errors in one run. Likely load-cancel race while GLTF/texture resources are inflight during rapid lifecycle changes. Repro 2 (GPU stall): mirror logs repeatedly show WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels', suggesting readback/render pressure during active camera+canvas operation. Limitation: nonzero real-pose landmarks could not be guaranteed from synthetic webcam alone due no human subject; validated pose-fitting behavior using TEST-ONLY worker interception fixture instead.
